headline: Sigma Solve reports September quarter financial results
summary: Sigma Solve Limited has submitted its financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026, to the stock exchange. The filing provides the company's financial performance for the second quarter of the fiscal year. Retail investors can review the reported revenue, profit margins, and operational metrics in the filing to assess the company's recent performance.
why_it_matters: Quarterly earnings data guides retail valuation checks.

headline: Sigma secures Rs 174 crore artillery ammunition order
hook: New export win for Hyderabad-based Sigma
summary: Hyderabad-based Sigma has received an order worth Rs 174 crore from a North American customer. The contract involves the supply of artillery ammunition subsystems. Execution of the order is scheduled to be completed by the second quarter of 2027.
why_it_matters: Boosts export revenue visibility for the company through 2027.
